skills.name: Composite - Transfer an object from one location to another
skills.description: Pick up an object from one location and place it in another location.

steps.activity: Pick up the object_to_transfer from the source_location
Carry the object_to_transfer to the destination_location
steps.category: Carry an object to a location

steps.activity: Place the object_to_transfer in the destination_location

examples: Carry roofing felt from a table and place it on a roof
Carry a shingle from a table and place it on a roof

skills.name: Composite - Spread a mat or sheet on a surface
skills.description: Unroll or unfold a mat or sheet and spread it on a surface.

steps.activity: Unroll or unfold the mat_or_sheet
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Position the mat_or_sheet on the surface

examples: Unroll roofing felt and spread it on a roof

skills.name: Composite - Attach an object to a particular location
skills.description: Position an object at a particular location and press it to attach it to that location.

steps.activity: Position the object_to_attach at the location_to_attach
Press the object_to_attach to attach it to the location_to_attach
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Stick a tile piece to a wall with mortar

skills.name: Composite - Measure trueness with a level
skills.description: Use a level to check whether a surface is level, plumb, or otherwise aligned.

steps.activity: Position the level on the surface_to_check
Check the bubble in the level to determine if the surface_to_check is level

examples: Check if the top of a cabinet is horizontal with a spirit level

skills.name: Composite - Hold two objects together with a quick action clamp
skills.description: Use a quick-action clamp to hold two objects together.

steps.activity: Extend the clamp to fit around the object_to_hold_1 and object_to_hold_2
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Position the clamp around the object_to_hold_1 and object_to_hold_2
Push the clamp head to tighten the clamp around the object_to_hold_1 and object_to_hold_2
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Squeeze the clamp handle to hold the object_to_hold_1 and object_to_hold_2 together

examples: Clamp a story pole to a wing wall template with a quick-action clamp

skills.name: Composite - Insert an object into a slot
skills.description: Position an object and insert it into a slot.

steps.activity: Grasp the holding_slot with one hand and hold it steady
Position the object_to_insert near the holding_slot with the other hand
Push the object_to_insert into the holding_slot to insert it
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Insert a curb key into a valve key base unit
Insert a handle into a valve key base unit

skills.name: Composite - Take out an object from a slot
skills.description: Take out an object from a slot by pulling it out.

steps.activity: Grasp the holding_slot with one hand and hold it steady
Pull the object_to_take_out out of the holding_slot to take it out
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Take a handle out of a valve key base unit
Take a curb key out of a valve key base unit

skills.name: Composite - Move an elongated object back and forth within an opening
skills.description: Move a long object back and forth within an opening by pushing and pulling it.

steps.activity: Position the elongated_object within the opening
Push the elongated_object into the opening
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Pull the elongated_object out of the opening
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Move a power washer wand back and forth within a drain pipe
Move a drain pipe back and forth through a tunnel beneath a walkway
